prompts.fox:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target/reference: the attached existing three-pet game artwork. Create ONE production battle sprite sheet for ONLY the LEFT orange fox: large triangular dark-tipped ears, cream muzzle/chest, dark brown paws, one very large fluffy orange tail with cream tip. Preserve that creature's distinctive colors, anatomy, cute personality and clean outlined cel-shaded monster-collecting JRPG art. This is an actual asset sheet, not a game screenshot.
Output layout: wide 2:1 transparent PNG, exactly TWO equal square cells side by side with broad empty gutters, no grid lines, no text, no shadows, no scenery. Each whole creature fits inside its own cell with 8 percent clear margin, all feet and tail included. Both drawings of exactly the same creature at matching scale.
LEFT CELL: PLAYER battle sprite. Camera BEHIND the creature and slightly above it, looking diagonally toward the upper-right opponent. Strong rear three-quarter view, body axis points up-right into depth, see the back of head, back/shoulders, rear legs and tail, with only a little far cheek visible. The creature is NOT looking back at the viewer; NO front-facing eyes. This must clearly be a back sprite, not a sideways profile mirrored. Tail can shift left to keep rear silhouette clear.
RIGHT CELL: ENEMY battle sprite. Camera in FRONT and slightly above the creature. Strong front three-quarter view, creature faces diagonally toward lower-left viewer/player, chest/front head visible, both eyes readable with nearer eye slightly larger, far legs correctly foreshortened. Body axis points down-left toward camera. NOT a lateral side profile. Use proper perspective and believable rounded volumes, as in classic Pokemon battle front/back staging.
Friendly focused battle-ready grounded stance; keep proportions and species identity of reference. Do not add equipment, limbs or additional creatures. Clean transparent alpha background. Only two drawings, left back and right front.
prompts.bud: A transparent 2:1 character turnaround sheet for a cheerful original cartoon garden creature. Two drawings side by side, matching size. It is a small light-green dinosaur on four short legs, with a long neck, cream-colored belly, two big green leaf-shaped ears, green round spots, a green tail and a large yellow daisy with leafy base growing on its upper back. Large friendly green eyes, bold clean outlines, polished colorful cel shading. LEFT: seen from behind at a three-quarter angle, looking away toward the upper right, showing the back of its head, shoulders, flower and tail. RIGHT: seen from the front at a three-quarter angle, looking toward the lower left, both eyes and its chest visible. Slightly elevated camera. Whole bodies including feet and tails, separated by a wide empty gutter. No text, no background, no ground shadows. Transparent PNG game asset.
